intro: Darn Talongrip is an orc scout stationed along the frontier of the Stonetalon Mountains near Malaka'jin. He monitors local threats in the crags and helps coordinate Horde communication between forward outposts and regional commanders.

p: Darn Talongrip watches the rugged ascents leading into Stonetalon from the southern Barrens. Stationed in the settlement of Malaka'jin, Darn directs recruits toward the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale. His post serves as an early line of contact for travelers winding upward into contested peaks.

From his post in Malaka'jin, Darn ensures messages and frontline reports reach key commanders like Kadrak at the watch tower in the northern Barrens. Outlying encampments in these mountains operate under constant pressure, making Darn's role as a sentry and courier essential to keeping the Horde vanguard informed.
